title: 331 Nazi War Film Shown at Hongkew Park

page_data.en:
MUNICIPAL POLICE
(S.B.) REGISTRY
331
28 / 8 / 40

CHINA PRESS.
AUG 22 1940

Nazi War Film
Shown At
Hongkew Park

Although the showing of similar
films was in the recent past banned
in the Settlement south of Soochow
Creek, a German war film was
shown free of charge before a
gathering of over 2,000 people in
the Hongkew Park Saturday night,
THE CHINA PRESS was reliably
informed yesterday.

A Japanese military band played
at the affair, it was stated.

Circles that learned of this show-
ing pointed out that the Hongkew
Park is within Settlement limits,
and that Settlement regulations for-
bid the showing of films tending to
have an inflammatory nature.

They stressed that the showing
of various films of the same nature
were prohibited in the Settlement in
the recent past, and the films had
to be exhibited in the French Con-
cession.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 22 Aug. 1940）

Commr. of Police.
Sir:
Information.
R. H. Yorke.
D. C. (Sp. Br.)
27/8.

工部局警务处
（特别处）档案室
331
40年8月28日

《字林西报》。
1940年8月22日

纳粹战争电影
在
虹口公园放映

尽管近期苏州河以南的公共租界已禁止放映此类影片，但据《字林西报》昨日从可靠渠道获悉，上周六晚，一部德国战争电影在虹口公园向两千多名观众免费放映。

据悉，活动期间有一支日本军乐队进行演奏。

获悉此次放映活动的人士指出，虹口公园位于公共租界范围内，而租界规章禁止放映具有煽动性质的电影。

他们强调，近期公共租界内已禁止放映各种同类性质的影片，这些影片不得不转至法租界放映。

（印：上海工部局警务处总监办公室 1940年8月22日）

致警务总监。
先生：
情报。
R. H. Yorke.
副督察长（特别处）
8月27日。

FORM
G. 65N-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
Dixwell Road Station. 3 1
Date August 26th, 1940. 46

REPORT

Subject (in full) Japanese Naval Band Concert & German War Propaganda Film.
Hongkew Park Band Stand, August 24th, 1940.
Made by S.I. W. Dow Forwarded by J. Wabay. Inspector
Officer i/c.

Sir,
I beg to report that a Naval Band Concert was held
in the Hongkew Park Band Stand on August 24th 1940 from
8.30 p.m. to 9.30 p.m. after which a German War Film was
shown from 9.35 p.m. to 11.00 p.m. under the auspices of
the Japanese Naval Landing Party in front of the Band
Stand. There was an attendance of approximately 2,000
persons which included 100 school children. There was
also several Foreigners mostly German Jews and Russians.
The film was more or less a War Propaganda Film. Showing
the Air Force engaged in Aerial War Fare with supposed
British Planes over Germany. The latter being driven off
by a lesser number of German planes.

Another part of the film showed the training of
German Police dogs by the German Army and their work
during Actual War Fare.

I cannot give any other details than above as I
had to leave at the request of My wife.

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently,
William Dow.
S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).
Information
W. Samson 26/8
DIVISIONAL OFFICER
"C" DIVISION.

（左侧手写批注：FILE）
（左侧边缘有模糊手写字迹及印章痕迹，难以辨认，此处转录不清）

卷宗号 工部局警务处
档案室
狄思威路捕房。 3 1
日期 1940年8月26日。 46

报告

主题（全称） 日本海军乐队音乐会及德国战争宣传电影。
虹口公园音乐台，1940年8月24日。
呈报人 警佐 W. Dow 经由 J. Wabay. 督察
主管警官转呈。

先生，
谨此报告，1940年8月24日晚8时30分至9时30分，在虹口公园音乐台举行了一场海军乐队音乐会，随后于晚9时35分至11时，在日本海军陆战队的主持下，在音乐台前放映了一部德国战争电影。出席人数约2000人，其中包括100名学童。此外还有数名外国人，多为德籍犹太人和俄国人。该影片大致是一部战争宣传片，展示了空军在德国上空与假想的英国飞机进行空战的情景。后者被数量较少的德国飞机击退。

影片的另一部分展示了德国军队训练德国警犬及其在实际作战中的工作情况。

除上述内容外，我无法提供更多细节，因我应妻子要求不得不离开。

先生，
您忠实的仆人，
William Dow.
警佐

副督察长（特别处）。
情报
W. Samson 8月26日
分区警官
“C”分区。
